en.name: Wahyu Patriaji
en.title: Programmer at PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk
en.summary: Software Engineer with hands-on experience building scalable web, backend, and cross-platform mobile applications using Node.js, HonoJS, React.js, React Native, and Flutter. Experienced in designing integrated systems that enable data sharing across multiple applications and implementing centralized SSO authentication for enterprise users. Strong background in system architecture, geospatial applications, legacy system modernization, performance optimization, deployment, and production application lifecycle management.

roles.title: Programmer (Full-Stack & Mobile Developer)
roles.summary: Contributed as a Fullstack Developer in building scalable web and mobile applications, leveraging the TypeScript ecosystem for both frontend and backend development.
highlights: Designed, built, and maintained scalable backend services using Node.js and modern frameworks like HonoJS.
Developed interactive and responsive web frontends using React.js, and efficiently managed application state with Redux Toolkit, and Zustand.
Integrated interactive maps using Leaflet and MapLibre for geospatial data visualization, including heatmaps, clustering, and real-time coordinate tracking.
Built cross-platform mobile applications for Android from scratch to production using Flutter and React Native.
Integrated multiple company projects and applications by designing data-sharing and interoperability solutions to enable seamless data synchronization and centralized data access.
Designed and implemented Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication for company employees, enabling centralized and secure access across multiple internal applications.
Developed and maintained legacy project using Laravel, PHP, and Node.js, including feature enhancements, bug fixing, performance optimization, and system refactoring.
Managed the deployment to VPS using Cloudpanel, ensuring high application availability and performance.
Implemented Redis as a caching layer and job queue to boost application speed and responsiveness.
Implemented Midtrans payment gateway to support secure and seamless in-app transactions.
Handled the entire mobile application release cycle to the Google Play Store, from build and testing to version updates.

roles.title: Mobile Developer
highlights: Develop Mobile Apps: Build and maintain high-performance, reusable code using React Native.
Collaborate with Teams: Work with product managers, designers, and developers to deliver products on time.
Optimize Performance: Fix bugs and optimize for performance and responsiveness.
API Integration: Connect applications to back-end services via RESTful APIs.
Implement UI/UX: Convert designs into user-friendly, visually appealing code.
Testing & Debugging: Write tests and debug for stability and performance.
Publish to Play Store: Handle app publishing, APK prep, and ensure Google Play compliance.

roles.title: Mobile Developer Intern
highlights: Assisted in building and maintaining high-performance mobile applications using React Native.
Collaborated with developers and designers to implement features and resolve issues.
Worked on UI/UX implementation to enhance the user interface based on design specifications.
Developed an understanding of integrating APIs for mobile app functionality.

education.institution: Bangkit Academy led by Google, Tokopedia, Gojek, & Traveloka
education.summary: Bangkit is a Google-led academy designed to produce high-calibre, technical talent for world-class, Indonesian technology companies and startups.
highlights: Participated as a mobile developer (Android) in the Bangkit program
Succeeded to reach top 68 best teams from 787 teams during the capstone phase
Learned valuable Android development skills, including UX design, background processes, and networking
Expertise in advanced UI, animation, localization, and working with Firebase and Google Maps API
Embraced challenges and committed to leveraging feedback for continuous improvement
Excelled in Time Management, Critical Thinking, Adaptability, Project Management, Professional Communication, and Digital Branding.

id.name: Wahyu Patriaji
id.title: Programmer di PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk
id.summary: Software Engineer dengan pengalaman praktis membangun aplikasi web, backend, dan mobile lintas platform yang scalable menggunakan Node.js, HonoJS, React.js, React Native, dan Flutter. Berpengalaman dalam merancang sistem terintegrasi yang memungkinkan berbagi data antar aplikasi dan mengimplementasikan autentikasi SSO terpusat untuk pengguna enterprise. Memiliki latar belakang kuat dalam arsitektur sistem, aplikasi spasial (GIS), modernisasi sistem legacy, optimasi performa, deployment, dan manajemen siklus hidup aplikasi produksi.

roles.title: Programmer (Full-Stack & Mobile Developer)
roles.summary: Berkontribusi sebagai Fullstack Developer dalam membangun aplikasi web dan mobile yang scalable, memanfaatkan ekosistem TypeScript untuk pengembangan frontend dan backend.
highlights: Merancang, membangun, dan memelihara layanan backend yang scalable menggunakan Node.js dan framework modern seperti HonoJS.
Mengembangkan antarmuka web interaktif dan responsif menggunakan React.js, serta mengelola state aplikasi secara efisien dengan Redux Toolkit dan Zustand.
Mengintegrasikan peta interaktif menggunakan Leaflet dan MapLibre untuk visualisasi data geospasial, termasuk heatmap, clustering, dan pelacakan koordinat real-time.
Membangun aplikasi mobile lintas platform untuk Android dari awal hingga produksi menggunakan Flutter dan React Native.
Mengintegrasikan berbagai proyek dan aplikasi perusahaan dengan merancang solusi interoperabilitas dan berbagi data untuk sinkronisasi data yang mulus serta akses data terpusat.
Merancang dan mengimplementasikan autentikasi Single Sign-On (SSO) untuk karyawan perusahaan, memungkinkan akses terpusat dan aman di berbagai aplikasi internal.
Mengembangkan dan memelihara proyek legacy menggunakan Laravel, PHP, dan Node.js, mencakup peningkatan fitur, perbaikan bug, optimasi performa, dan refactoring sistem.
Mengelola deployment ke VPS menggunakan Cloudpanel, memastikan ketersediaan tinggi dan performa aplikasi yang optimal.
Mengimplementasikan Redis sebagai lapisan caching dan antrean pekerjaan (job queue) untuk meningkatkan kecepatan dan responsivitas aplikasi.
Mengintegrasikan payment gateway Midtrans untuk mendukung transaksi dalam aplikasi yang aman dan lancar.
Menangani seluruh siklus rilis aplikasi mobile ke Google Play Store, mulai dari proses build, pengujian, hingga pembaruan versi.

roles.title: Mobile Developer
highlights: Pengembangan Aplikasi Mobile: Membangun dan memelihara kode berkinerja tinggi serta dapat digunakan kembali menggunakan React Native.
Kolaborasi Tim: Bekerja sama dengan product manager, desainer, dan developer untuk menyelesaikan produk tepat waktu.
Optimasi Performa: Memperbaiki bug serta mengoptimalkan performa dan responsivitas aplikasi.
Integrasi API: Menghubungkan aplikasi ke layanan backend melalui RESTful API.
Implementasi UI/UX: Mengubah desain menjadi kode yang ramah pengguna dan menarik secara visual.
Pengujian & Debugging: Menulis pengujian dan melakukan debugging untuk kestabilan dan performa.
Publikasi ke Play Store: Menangani publikasi aplikasi, persiapan APK, dan memastikan kepatuhan standar Google Play.

roles.title: Mobile Developer Intern
highlights: Membantu membangun dan memelihara aplikasi mobile berkinerja tinggi menggunakan React Native.
Bekerja sama dengan developer dan desainer untuk mengimplementasikan fitur dan menyelesaikan masalah.
Bekerja dalam pengimplementasian UI/UX untuk meningkatkan antarmuka pengguna berdasarkan spesifikasi desain.
Mengembangkan pemahaman dalam mengintegrasikan API untuk fungsionalitas aplikasi mobile.
